Elena (People Ops): Quick heads-up  new travel & leave clarifications rolling out June 15. TL;DR + links below, full policy in the HR portal.

Elena (People Ops): 1) International travel safety addendum: employees traveling for work or extended relocations must complete a short 3-question pre-travel check-in (health, visa, emergency contact). Company will cover emergency hotel/evac costs approved by People Ops for qualifying events. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/travel-safety-2026

Elena (People Ops): 2) Paid time for moving households (relocation support update): up to 3 paid days for domestic moves, 5 paid days for international relocations when Redwood coordinates the move. Submit relocation request via HR portal before booking.

hr-bot: Policy docs updated (version 2026-06-15): https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/relocation-travel-2026

Theo R.: If I'm on a short-term customer trip (3 days) and miss my kid's school event, can I use VTO or comp-time?

Elena (People Ops): Use VTO for volunteering/school events. For missed family events because of travel you can request comp-time accrual for qualifying overnight trips; manager approval required. See the comp-time use table in the policy.

Maya L.: For emergency hotel/evac approval, how quick is the turnaround? Last year it took a while during a regional storm.

Elena (People Ops): For safety-critical approvals we now have a 24-hr fast-track triage (weekdays). In declared regional emergencies we escalate to on-call People Ops and payroll will process emergency pay same cycle. If you anticipate risk file the pre-travel check-in to get proactive support.

payroll-bot: Reminder: relocation paid days will be reflected on your payslip and are subject to local tax rules. The portal will show estimated tax treatment when you file the relocation claim.

Theo R.: Does the pre-travel check-in apply to personal travel when I'm working remote abroad for >30 days?

Elena (People Ops): Yes, any remote work stint outside your home country over 30 days requires the check-in and an approved remote work abroad form. This helps us handle payroll, tax, and safety. Reach out to people-ops@redwood.com to start the form.

Maya L.: Office hours Friday 11am PT in #people-ops-office-hours for questions and help filing relocation or check-in forms. Thanks! :airplane: :house_with_garden:
